findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/evidence.js::check-then-act gap between placement and the write in placespecreviewevidence
findings.title: check-then-act gap between placement and the write in placeSpecReviewEvidence
findings.action: Re-verify the target with a no-follow check at rename time
findings.disposition_rationale: The write goes to the realpath captured at placement; swapping it needs local write access inside the repository between two syscalls. guardWriterPaths, which every evidence writer uses, has the same check-time posture, and the spec asks for the same narrowness, not a stronger control.

occurrences.title: check-then-act gap between placement and the write in placeSpecReviewEvidence
